title: One of the best
body:
Good all round. One of the top two on the app store in my opinion. Look no further if you found this one.

However, there's a few unusual choices. Like every habit has a time associated with it, and a time to next start, both of which are shown at all times. It just clutters up the UI in my opinion and takes up space. Let me turn that off please.

There's no health app integration, but I'm yet to find an app with all the health integration I want.

Still, this is one of the top two - and the best priced of all.

author: Siowhat

title: I’ve never felt so moved to leave a review for an app
body:
That may say it all. 

Has all the features lacking in many others! 

The only reason it’s not 5 star is.... it would be even better if the timeline view had the option of getting rid of the extra info, like overdue, done in a row, time of event. 
The timeline is the bit you’d use every day, multiple times a day, so really you want it as streamlined and simple as possible. I do think this is an excellent suggestion, if I do say so myself 😉

Update to this review:-
So many glitches in this app. 
After a few days, now the voice prompts have stopped working. Some features were never working, which would be useful, like changing the time of the end of the day (is not working, it still renews at midnight), as well as other features that don’t work- daily checkin reminder. 

This seems to be the most expensive app for what it does, which would be fine if it was working with no glitches. 
Will change this to 2 stars if it’s not working out...

title: It does what it says
body:
The app does exactly what you expect it to 
Some of the pros, compared to other apps I’ve tried, is you can set monthly tasks for things you want done once a month or for example every two weeks.
You can also set specific times for each habit and set how many times the app should remind you 
It just does exactly what I need it to.

However there are so many small tweaks in terms of design that can create a much slicker looking app
The front screen can appear very messy once you’ve set up all your habits because it states underneath each habit how many times you’ve repeated it (weekly on mon,tue,wed,thurs .......) 
The blue (i) info button under done feels more like an error button 
Just small things that once changed would improve the visual aspect drastically 
It’s just very cluttered for an organisation app. 

To sum it up: I think the design really needs a major update for massive improvement but the functionality is great nonetheless therefore I’ll keep using it

title: Perfect for procrastinators
body:
This app is bang on for those of us that know what we are supposed to be doing but browse Facebook instead. Due to my work I struggle to keep routine and this really helps.

Build your own routine (I suggest paying the £2.99 for unlimited daily routines, no I’m not affiliated)and basically use it to get your day on the right track every day. It alerts you with an audible tone when a task is due and that helps motivate you to start.

Simple but decent, works with Apple Watch.
